# Salvage Specialist
1. You report directly to the Salvage Lead. If there is no salvage lead, one may be elected by the team.
This procedure is as follows: - The salvage team is to report back to the ATS after any expedition. - Any contraband and weaponry found is to be stored in the ATS armoury. The Salvage Leader may approve items for use. - Salvage material should be stored for trade with the local station. - Any damage to the ship/crew must be reported and repaired.
2. Salvage's primary directive is the defense and upkeep of the Automated Trade Station.
- Hostile threats onboard the ATS may be dispatched by Salvage, and should be turned over to Station Security without delay once incapacitated. - Hostile threats actively causing damage to the ATS may be dispatched by Salvage, but should not be pursued once they are no longer an active threat to the ATS. - The Automated Trade Station should remain powered, breathable, and pressurized at all times. - The Automated Trade Station should not be moved closer or further from the assigned Space Station at any time unless it is for the preservation of the ATS from extreme damages. - The ATS may be used as shelter in times of great emergency. Outside of these scenarios, it is an asset of the Trade Guild and should not be used for non-commerce related tasks by anyone but the Salvage team guarding it.
3. Highly dangerous expeditions may only be undertaken with the express permission of the Salvage Lead. Going on unauthorized expeditions is grounds for demotion.
4. Contraband found while on an expedition may only be used with authorization from the Salvage Lead.
5. Salvage specialists are only authorized to enter local stations under arms when the ITG services have been formally contracted over secure console purchase
6. Salvage Specialists are expected to follow Space Law and regulations when aboard local stations as visitors. When under contract, Salvage specialists are expected to maintain professionality and cohesion.
7. Machinery may not be moved from the station to ITG shuttles of facilities.
